list.d: [[p:557715517|E.Marquez]] is penciled in as a starter for the first time. Add this: LSU threw it more than almost anyone last year (3rd in passing yards per game). Plus, he brings a speedster skill set to a scheme that ranks 2nd in receptions. By October, everyone will know it.
